item.title: What Must a Navier–Stokes Singularity Actually Do?
item.description: I asked the current frontier models to attack the 3D Navier–Stokes regularity problem from first principles. They did not solve it — but they came back with an exact spectral-centre identity, a strict Lyapunov functional, and a much sharper description of what a hypothetical blow-up would have to accomplish.
